text:
Maria R.: Quick heads-up — I'm drafting the release notes and internal announcement for tomorrow's quiet push. Need a final pin decision for the model + rollback criteria. Drop edits here.
Jack H.: thanks — adding the bullet list now. will ping ops for SLA blurb.
Sasha I.: can we pin the runtime image to `inference:3.2.1`? saw a perf wobble in canary yesterday.
Maria R.: Sasha — that's the ask. Proposal: pin `model:v3.2.0` and runtime `inference:3.2.1` for canary; if canary fails we'll fallback to `model:v3.1.8` cluster-wide. ok?
Kevin T.: +1 on fallback to v3.1.8. need to define failure metric — suggest error rate >1.5% or p95 latency increase >30% vs baseline.
Liz M.: can we make that explicit in the notes? ops needs exact thresholds for the playbook.
Maria R.: yes — will include exact gates. Draft snippet below — please react with :thumbsup: to approve or leave comment.
Maria R.: ```
Release notes (internal):
- Target deploy: 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC (quiet window)
- Models: primary = model:v3.2.0 (pinned); fallback = model:v3.1.8
- Runtime: inference:3.2.1 (pinned)
- Rollback criteria (canary/early): error rate >1.5% OR p95 latency +30% vs baseline over 5m window -> automatic rollback to model:v3.1.8
- Owner: @Kevin T. (deploy lead), ops-oncall (evac)
- Notes: minor ranking fix, no schema changes. No consumer-facing behavior expected.
```
Sasha I.: looks good, but add a line about embeddings evaluation — last run looked fine, just mention pass/fail gating.
Maria R.: good call. adding "embedding regression test must pass (diff <0.5% AUC drop)".
Jack H.: ops-oncall — can you confirm standby rota and that deploy-bot will alert if canary crosses thresholds?
ops-oncall: confirmed. deploy-bot alerts wired to #eng-oncall and pages escalation at 1.75% error by default.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z -> stage: canary (10%), rollout: 60m linear. Monitors: p95_latency, error_rate, embedding_auc.
Kevin T.: planning a dry-run tonight at 23:30 UTC in staging. will post results. please don't edit the pinned versions until after dry-run unless critical.
Liz M.: I'll draft the internal announcement copy (short) and a one-paragraph ops playbook. sharing in ~30m.
Maria R.: thanks all. if no objections by EOD I'll send the internal note and pin the release in the deploy queue. :white_check_mark:
Jack H.: :thumbsup:
Sasha I.: :thumbsup:
Kevin T.: :thumbsup:
